title: Post Processor AI — CPS Architecture & Controller Intelligence

units.title: 16 Post Processor AI domains with Claude Opus prompts
units.details: Added 16 POST-AI domains: post_cps_structure (CPS file architecture), post_output_format (G-code block structure), post_modal_groups (G/M-code modality), post_canned_cycles (drilling/tapping/boring), post_tool_change (ATC sequences), post_coordinate_systems (G54-G59), post_arc_handling (IJ/R format), post_coolant_control (M-codes), post_spindle_control (CSS/rigid tap), post_axis_mapping (rotary axes), post_probing_output (Renishaw/Blum), post_subprogram (macro calls), post_safety_blocks (startup/shutdown), post_controller_dialect (Fanuc/Siemens/Heidenhain/Haas/Mazak/Okuma), post_debugging (troubleshooting), post_customization (modification)

summary: Complete post processor AI intelligence with 16 domains covering CPS file architecture, G-code output formatting, modal groups, canned cycles, tool changes, coordinate systems, arc handling, coolant/spindle control, axis mapping, probing output, subprograms, safety blocks, controller dialects, debugging, and customization. Deep expertise from 175+ CPS files and Post Processor Training Guide.
